summary: Iteration 235 - Batch 23 (Forecast V2: 24-month horizon + Demand Calendar + Pickup Curve) tested. Backend: 18/18 passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified and interactive features working.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/forecast-v2/horizon/{property_id}?months=24 returns forecast[] with 24 items, each containing {period, label, bookings, revenue, adr, los, confidence, vs_last_year}
Horizon endpoint validates months 3..36 (rejects 0 and 40 with 400)
GET /api/forecast-v2/demand-calendar/{property_id}?days=90 returns days[] with {date, dow, occupancy_pct, otb, demand_score, tier, tier_label, holiday, is_weekend}
Demand calendar validates days 7..365 (rejects 5 and 400 with 400)
Tier logic verified: score>=80 peak, >=60 high, >=40 medium, >=20 low, <20 trough
GET /api/forecast-v2/pickup-curve/{property_id}?target_date=YYYY-MM-DD returns actual_curve (91 points), historical_avg_curve, pace_vs_hist_pct, pace_status
Pickup curve rejects invalid date formats with 400
RBAC: horizon and pickup-curve require admin/manager, demand-calendar allows receptionist
All 3 endpoints require auth (401 without token)
Frontend uses Turkish labels: '24 Ay Ufku', 'Talep Takvimi', 'Pickup Eğrisi'
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing property 'default' with ~5 test bookings
